name: Git
description: WebStorm-style Git log for Orca: branches, commits and the files of a multi-commit selection with a side-by-side diff. Fork of emamalet/Orca-git-log-panel.

cover.alt: Git tab with the branches, commits, files and details sections on the left and a side-by-side diff of a TypeScript file on the right

screenshots.alt: Six selected commits across two merges, the files they changed as a tree, and a side-by-side diff of one file
screenshots.caption: Select commits, see the files of the whole selection and a highlighted diff beside them

screenshots.alt: Unified diff of a TypeScript file with added and removed lines and syntax highlighting
screenshots.caption: Unified or side-by-side diff with syntax highlighting

screenshots.alt: Branches section expanded: local and remote branches grouped into folders by prefix
screenshots.caption: Branch tree grouped into folders, with checkout, rename, merge and rebase actions

settings.title: Git executable
settings.description: Path or name of the git binary used by the log.

settings.title: Commits per page
settings.description: How many commits are loaded at once while scrolling.
